title: ParlayAPI stopped serving Pinnacle on Nov 9: app and engine updated (v1.0.104)
body: The failing job was the grader asking ParlayAPI for Pinnacle closing lines (117 refused calls a run, repeated every run). Fixed: closes now ask DraftKings and FanDuel moneylines (soft books, labelled that way, after ESPN), a refused book is a 'never', and no ParlayAPI request names Pinnacle any more. Alternate lines were Pinnacle's alone: every league returned 0 lines but cost 2 of 5 credits, so they are off (3 credits a league). Line moves now say FanDuel. Pinnacle is still in ParlayAPI's 1st-half lines (NFL, NCAAF) only; PropLine carries it for the rest. The Business plan ends Nov 20 (period end 23:37 UTC): ParlayAPI fed 2,304 lines of which only 32 no other source had (PropLine 16,772 and 6,978), so whether to renew is your call; without it the engine runs on the Starter key, the free keys and PropLine. The engine picks the change up at its next 6-hour handover. Details: PARLAY_API.md section 11.
